channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Canada posts the clearest overnight conversion print while Texas stays on the audit clock. Bell Canada and Saskatchewan announced a non-binding MOU on 14 Sep to expand Bell AI Fabric by up to 900 MW of phased BYOP capacity on top of the 300 MW Sherwood path already drawing from the provincial grid — a named route to a 1.2 GW Canadian AI hub, still gated by customers, permits and commercial close. On the US grid side, PUCT Project 58481 (§25.194) still shows no stamped Order Adopting through Interchange item 217 (14 Sep public comment only), and Howard–Solstice (59336) remains press-approved without a written Order visible. Batch Zero verification RFIs keep running toward the ~Sep 23 response clock and Dec 10 reports. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 69 re-read list prints.

item.description: Canada posts the clearest overnight conversion print while Texas stays on the audit clock. Bell Canada and Saskatchewan announced a non-binding MOU on 14 Sep to expand Bell AI Fabric by up to 900 MW of phased BYOP capacity on top of the 300 MW Sherwood path already drawing from the provincial grid — a named route to a 1.2 GW Canadian AI hub, still gated by customers, permits and commercial close. On the US grid side, PUCT Project 58481 (§25.194) still shows no stamped Order Adopting through Interchange item 217 (14 Sep public comment only), and Howard–Solstice (59336) remains press-approved without a written Order visible. Batch Zero verification RFIs keep running toward the ~Sep 23 response clock and Dec 10 reports. Countries: Canada / Saskatchewan: Bell × SK MOU 14 Sep: path to 1.2 GW (300 MW grid + ≤900 MW BYOP gas). Non-binding; customer/permit gated. Capex framing >$50B at full buildout. United States / Texas: Project 58481 / §25.194: still no Order Adopting on Interchange through item 217 (14 Sep). Do not treat as adopted. United States / Texas: PUCT 59336 Howard–Solstice: press-approved 11 Sep with landowner route mods; written Order still pending on Interchange as of 15 Sep morning PT. United States / Texas: Batch Zero MW book (66.4 GW base / ~128 GW studied) still live; verification RFI ~Sep 23; community survey mid-Oct; Dec 10 reports.
